purpose: Collect and remove only the preserved failed HOLY-127 receipt, then atomically update the already-installed fixed qualifier surfaces. This packet does not run qualification.

requiredGates: After export reports 3379 bytes and a SHA-256, use normal deploy SSH to copy /var/tmp/holy127-failed-receipt-export-20261029a.json off-host byte-for-byte; require non-empty valid JSON, operation holy127-q-f4f5a94-20261029a, status failed, and the same SHA-256 before cleanup.

Run cleanup only after off-host receipt validation; it requires byte equality between the original and root-owned 0444 export, and its printed SHA-256 must equal the off-host receipt hash. Prove both the fixed receipt directory and export file absent.
The updater refuses while the preserved receipt directory exists, any installed old hash differs, the shared lock is busy or incompatible, or the new archive differs.
Require updater JSON status updated and verify all five installed new hashes. Qualification requires a later fresh Product slot and a new exclusive operation ID.
mutationScope: Exclusively create one root-owned mode-0444 nonsecret export in sticky /var/tmp; after verified off-host capture, remove only that byte-matched export, the exact preserved qualification.json and then its empty fixed receipt directory.
Replace only five hash-verified root-owned fixed files: disposable qualifier, qualifier entrypoint, receipt collector, receipt cleanup and installer.
Never touch the live app/database, production, DB settings, secrets, sudo policy, existing /run/lock, or any Docker resource.
authorization: Packet publication is not execution. Product must review the exact packet and use the persisted NJ staging installation authority; a new qualification run still requires a fresh serialized slot.
